newsitem.title: USA: U.S. electric utility bill introduced in Senate.
newsitem.headline: U.S. electric utility bill introduced in Senate.

text.p: A bill to require competition for electric utility services by the end of the year 2003 was introduced Thursday by Senator Dale Bumpers, (D-Ark.).
The bill requires that all consumers have the right to purchase retail electric energy beginning on Dec. 15, 2003.
It also requires that all retail electric energy suppliers have access to local distribution and retail transmission facilities beginning on the same date.
The bill gives states the right to require retail electric competition before 2003.
Bumpers said competition would mean lower electric rates for customers.
